checklistText: Ghosting on foliage and moving elements: doubled or semi-transparent edges where something moved between brackets (AutoHDR QC checklist, Oct 13 2026)

escalateTo.when: the ghosting is on the primary or hero exterior, or covers a large, obvious part of the frame

deescalateTo.when: a small, peripheral ghost a viewer is unlikely to notice

visionHint: Check all greenery, branches, flags, water, and any car or person seen through windows for doubled, semi-transparent or smeared edges left by movement between bracketed frames. Do not flag natural motion blur in a water feature, depth-of-field softness, or reflections.

checklistText: Test shots, misfires and accidental captures in the delivery set (AutoHDR QC checklist, Oct 13 2026)

escalateTo.when: the frame is unusable: mostly black or white, lens cap, floor or ceiling only, or the photographer's hand or feet

visionHint: Flag frames that are clearly not deliverable: a lens cap or blank exposure, a shot of the floor, ceiling or sky by accident, a settings or color-card test, the photographer's hand or feet, or a frame cut mid-movement. The fix is to exclude the photo from delivery. Do not flag an intentional detail or close-up shot.

sectionName: Reflections, Dust, Glare, and Unwanted Objects
checklistText: Drone visible in windows, glass, mirrors or other reflections (AutoHDR QC checklist, Oct 13 2026)

deescalateTo.when: a tiny, distant speck that is only identifiable on close inspection

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the drone reflected in the {location}. Keep the glass, frame and reflection of the scene unchanged. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Look for a drone (a small quadcopter shape, often with visible rotors) reflected in windows, glass doors, pools, car paint or other shiny surfaces, especially in aerial and exterior photos. Do not flag birds, insects or distant aircraft in the sky.

checklistText: The client ordered a virtual twilight: suggest the photo(s) to turn into a twilight shot (Jordan, Oct 14 2026)
The client ordered virtual staging: suggest the empty room(s) to stage (Jordan, Oct 14 2026)
The client ordered virtual decluttering: suggest the most cluttered room(s) (Jordan, Oct 14 2026)
A real twilight was ordered and this dusk photo was edited with the day look: re-render it with the twilight model (Jordan, Oct 14 2026)
An AI fix changed the house or damaged the photo and the previous version could not be put back automatically: restore the earlier version in the lightbox (Oct 14 2026 huddle)
A door mat left crooked, flipped up or bunched at an entry door, inside or on the porch (Jordan, Oct 15 2026)

escalateTo.when: the mat sits at the front door in a primary or hero exterior

reeditPromptTemplate: Straighten the door mat {location} so it lies flat and square to the door, keeping its size, color and pattern. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Flag a door mat at an entry door (inside, or on the porch or stoop) that sits visibly crooked to the door, is flipped or folded up at a corner, or is bunched. Do not flag a mat that lies flat and square, or an area rug away from a door.

checklistText: An empty (vacant) room with a loose item left behind that a photographer could have moved out of the frame (Jordan, Oct 15 2026)
shortLabel: Item left in an empty room

deescalateTo.when: the item is tiny or far in the background

reeditPromptTemplate: Remove the loose item {location} and fill in only the floor, wall or counter behind it. Change nothing else in the photo.
visionHint: Only in an EMPTY room (no furniture): flag any loose item left behind on the floor, counters or sills, such as a bag, a box, a bottle, a tool, a cord, a paper or trash. Do not flag fixtures, built-ins, appliances, window treatments or anything attached to the house.

checklistText: Walls, door frames, windows or cabinets that look bent, curved or wedge-shaped (architecture only, never furniture) (Jordan, Oct 15 2026)
visionHint: Flag walls, wall corners, door frames, windows or cabinets that look bent, curved, stretched into a wedge, or wavy, usually near the edges of the frame. Architecture only: never furniture, never the normal look of a wide room. Do not flag designed curves (arches, round walls).
cvHint: Edge chains on a 1024 px luma image (near-vertical, and near-horizontal on the transposed image): fit a straight line to each long chain; a chain whose bow (max minus min residual) exceeds 3 px and 1.2% of its length is bent; two or more bent chains flag. Starting values, calibrate.

checklistText: A room the listing needs was photographed (it is in AutoHDR's photos) but is not in the delivered set (Oct 15 2026)
A room the listing needs was never photographed (not in AutoHDR's photos of the shoot) (Oct 15 2026)

deescalateTo.when: nice-to-have coverage, or a view inside a room that is otherwise covered

checklistText: AutoHDR returned fewer photos than the uploaded bracket sets should make (Oct 15 2026)

Floating or unsupported objects left by the edit: a lamp, piece of furniture or decor hovering with nothing under it, an object cut off in mid-air, or a doubled or ghost copy of an object (Oct 22 2026, 615 Cliff Ln: the bedroom lamp floating beside the crib)
visionHint: Look at what every lamp, piece of furniture and decor item rests on. Flag one that hovers with no table, floor or shelf under it (a table lamp floating where its nightstand should be), an object that ends abruptly in mid-air, or the same object shown twice or as a faint ghost copy. Do not flag fixtures that really hang or mount (pendants, chandeliers, sconces, wall shelves, mounted TVs or art), objects standing on glass or clear acrylic, or furniture whose thin legs are visible.
